title: IndicDBBench - Benchmarking Multilingual Text-to-SQL Capabilities in Indian Languages
abstract: arXiv:2604.13686v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced Text-to-SQL performance, existing benchmarks largely focus on Western contexts leaving a gap in real-world, non-Western applications. We introduce IndicDBBench, a comprehensive multilingual Text-to-SQL benchmark designed to evaluate cross-lingual semantic parsing across diverse Indic language families. The underlying schemas are derived from real-world open-data platforms (NDAP and IDP), ensuring realistic structural complexity. IndicDBBench comprises 20 databases spanning 237 tables. To construct complex relational structures from denormalized government data, we employ a three-agent pipeline (Architect, Auditor, Refiner), achieving high relational density (11.85 tables per database) and join depths of up to six. translated_title: IndicDBBench——面向印度语言的多语言文本到SQL能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已显著提升了文本到SQL的性能，但现有基准测试大多聚焦于西方语境，在真实世界的非西方应用方面留下了空白。我们提出IndicDBBench，这是一个全面的多语言文本到SQL基准，旨在评估跨越多种印度语系语言的跨语言语义解析能力。其底层数据库模式源自真实世界的开放数据平台（NDAP和IDP），确保了真实的结构复杂性。IndicDBBench包含20个数据库，涵盖237张表。为了从非规范化的政府数据中构建复杂的关系结构，我们采用了三智能体流水线（架构师、审计员、精炼者），实现了较高的关系密度（每个数据库平均11.85张表）以及最深达六层的连接深度。我们生成了涵盖七种语言（英语和六种印度语言）的15,612个任务，确保查询基于真实的数据库取值，并需要多步骤推理（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了IndicDBBench，一个基于真实政府开放数据、通过三智能体流水线构建的覆盖英语及六种印度语言共15,612个任务、20个数据库的大型多语言Text-to-SQL基准，填补了现有基准在非西方语言语境下的评测空白。
en_tdlr: IndicDBBench is a large-scale multilingual Text-to-SQL benchmark built from real government open-data via a three-agent pipeline, spanning seven languages (English and six Indic languages) with 20 databases and 15,612 tasks, filling the evaluation gap for non-Western cross-lingual semantic parsing.
